MESSAGE: I can use his crystal to call him down.
Hey Warren! You needed help, right?
He's very strong. How could I possibly help?
Great plan! I'll trick him back, don't you worry!
Let me use some magic Warren taught me once to hide this ball
What if we traded? I have something better.
It's.. the Tennis Ball of Power!
Fine! On condition, you give me the Wand of Fetching.
Lemme meet Warren at my House!
Ah it's great to be me!
Thanks to that wizard, I can become even stronger than before.
Ugh. What are you doing here?
Here for Warren's wand aren't you?
HA! There's no ways you do.
Ha, loser! Enjoy that boring stick.
I'm glad you could make it!
That brute, Bruno.. He stole my Wand of Fetching
You'll just have to trick him!
Just a normal tennis ball, but!
I put a colour spell on it for a short time to make it seem special.
Trade Bruno this tennis ball for my wand, I'm sure it will work!
That's the spirit! Now go get 'em!
I'll keep watch from my tower - he'll be in the park by now.
